candidateEmissionApi.firstArgument: the frozen ExtractionInput. NOT ExtractionDebug, NOT a FieldSelection, NOT a candidate array.
candidateEmissionApi.returnsOnFailure: the extractor's typed ExtractionError, unchanged, with no diagnostic selection and no candidate record
candidateEmissionApi.opaqueIdentitySource: input.artifactRef — there is no second identifier that could disagree with it
internalSteps: validate input.artifactRef matches ^item-\\d{4}$, before any extractor invocation
return the extractor's typed failure unchanged when it returns !ok
keep DetailedExtractionResult and ExtractionDebug private until that call succeeds
reconstruct the exact Brand pass set: primary OBSERVED ? [debug.passes[0]] : debug.passes
perform full-object parity internally against debug.finalSelections.brand
finalize the complete internally derived candidate population
return the original detailed result, the diagnostic selection and the candidate records together
supersededRoutes: a bare candidate array (Amendment 8 and earlier)
a caller-supplied FieldSelection (Amendment 9): a filtered population could be wrapped in a freshly constructed selection
a caller-supplied ExtractionDebug (Amendment 10): a helper could filter or reorder the passes and reconstruct matching primary and final selections
candidateEmissionApi.whyExtractorOwned: Each earlier signature closed the route it named and left an adjacent one open. Owning the extractor call removes the class: there is no caller-supplied evidence at all, and the runner never holds an intermediate it could alter.
candidateEmissionApi.runtimeExportSurfaceVerifiedBy: importing the module namespace and inspecting its actual runtime own keys, not a source regex

haltCodes.MALFORMED_ARTIFACT_REF: input.artifactRef does not match ^item-\\d{4}$; raised before the extractor is invoked
haltCodes.DEBUG_PASSES_ABSENT: the extractor's debug carries no ordered pass array
haltCodes.BRAND_DIAGNOSTIC_SELECTION_PARITY_FAILUR: the internally derived selection differs from debug.finalSelections.brand once only the two complete-diagnostics fields are removed
haltCodes.COMPLETE_DIAGNOSTICS_ABSENT: the internally derived selection carries no brandDiagnostics.candidates array
haltCodes.CANDIDATE_EVIDENCE_TRUNCATED: the emitted record count does not equal the internally derived diagnostic candidate count
haltCodes.RANKED_MEMBERSHIP_INCONSISTENT: decision, ranking and rankedPosition are mutually inconsistent, or a kept population retains no ranked survivor
haltCodes.RANKED_POSITION_PARITY_FAILURE: ranked positions are not unique or contiguous, or there is not exactly one selected candidate
